rationale: Use measured, correct Gm1 as the base (0.054595 s, score 0.894909). Test whether Gm2’s persistent, contiguous z-slab ownership improves on Gm1’s static collapsed worksharing while retaining Gm1’s hoisted row pointers and guarded OpenMP SIMD x-loop. Preserve the six-step recurrence, buffer parity, full initialization, thread budget, and synchronization between dependent steps. Gm2 is also correct but slightly slower overall (0.055090 s), so this is an unverified interaction to measure, not an assumed gain. Do not carry over T4’s x-unrolling variants, which were slower than Gm1.
